name: @kaneo/desktop
description: Kaneo project management Tauri desktop app
author: Kaneo contributors

scripts.prepare:runtime: VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1337 VITE_CLIENT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY= pnpm --filter @kaneo/web build && node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs
scripts.start: pnpm prepare:runtime && cd ../../rust/crates/kaneo-desktop && KANEO_WEB_ROOT=../../../apps/desktop/runtime/web cargo tauri dev
scripts.package: pnpm build:rust && pnpm prepare:runtime && cd ../../rust/crates/kaneo-desktop && NO_STRIP=1 cargo tauri build
scripts.package:dir: pnpm build:rust && pnpm prepare:runtime && cd ../../rust/crates/kaneo-desktop && NO_STRIP=1 cargo tauri build --no-bundle
scripts.package:appimage: pnpm build:rust && pnpm prepare:runtime && cd ../../rust/crates/kaneo-desktop && NO_STRIP=1 cargo tauri build --bundles appimage
